sky-beach.name: Sky Beach
sky-beach.building: The Standard, Bangkok Mahanakhon · King Power Mahanakhon
sky-beach.intro: End the day looking across Bangkok in every direction at Sky Beach. This open-air bar at the top of Mahanakhon Tower pairs the city’s buildings and lights with cocktails and casual American food. Bring friends who enjoy DJ music for an evening of music and skyline views. Arrive before sunset to watch the daytime city give way to its night-time lights.

facts.children: All ages welcome, according to the hotel’s official FAQ
facts.booking: Admission and seating are first come, first served; use the main King Power Mahanakhon entrance

reasons.title: From the daytime skyline to city lights
reasons.text: Look out across central Bangkok in every direction. Follow the buildings and roads during the day, then see the city fill with lights after dark. It is a good setting for photographs with friends or enjoying Bangkok’s wide cityscape with family.

reasons.title: Finish the day with cocktails and DJ music
reasons.text: Enjoy DJ music with cocktails and casual American food. After sightseeing, spend the evening talking over the day with friends as you look out at the city. Admission and seats are first come, first served, so do not arrive assuming a reserved table awaits.

sky-beach.menu: Pair casual American food with cocktails. Choose your favourite drinks with friends and take your time enjoying the city view. Browse the menu through the official information below.
sky-beach.recommended: A good choice for friends who enjoy DJ music and broad city views, or families wanting to see Bangkok from above.
sky-beach.bestTime: Arrive before sunset for the city and sky, then stay after dark to see Bangkok filled with lights.
sky-beach.reservation: Admission and seating are first come, first served. Choose your companions and time, then follow the admission instructions on arrival.
sky-beach.entrance: Enter through King Power Mahanakhon’s main entrance. If driving, you can use Mahanakhon Cube’s car park.

access.name: Chong Nonsi BTS station
access.instructions: Leave Chong Nonsi station on the BTS Silom Line through Exit 3 and walk towards King Power Mahanakhon. Use the main entrance and follow the admission directions for Sky Beach.

taxi.instructions: Search for “King Power Mahanakhon” in Grab or Bolt. In a taxi, show the driver the English or Thai sentence below. On arrival, tell the staff you are visiting Sky Beach.
taxi.english: Please take me to King Power Mahanakhon. I am going to Sky Beach.
taxi.thai: ไปคิง เพาเวอร์ มหานคร จะไป Sky Beach

sources: Official hotel hours, ages, seating and menu
sky-beach.locationNote: Centre of the King Power Mahanakhon building boundary in OSM, not a surveyed entrance or rooftop position.
sky-beach.skyWalk: The hotel says Sky Beach guests can enter the SkyWalk after 19:00. Check ticket and same-day access conditions before visiting.
faq: Who would enjoy a visit?

Bring friends who enjoy DJ music and broad city views, or family who would like to see Bangkok from above. Look out across central Bangkok in every direction, following buildings and roads during the day and the lights after dark. It is a good setting for photographs with friends or seeing the city together as a family.
Can I bring children?
Yes, families can visit without an age restriction and enjoy looking across the city together. Admission and seating are first come, first served.
Can I visit late in the evening?
It opens daily from 10:00 to midnight, with last admission at 23:00. Late visits are possible, but arrive with time to spare if you want to enjoy the view and drinks at a relaxed pace.
Which entrance should I use?
Use King Power Mahanakhon’s main entrance. By train, leave Chong Nonsi BTS station through Exit 3 and walk towards Mahanakhon. Once inside, follow the Sky Beach admission directions.

hongs-sky-bar.name: HONG’s Sky Bar
hongs-sky-bar.building: InterContinental Chiang Mai The Mae Ping · rooftop
hongs-sky-bar.intro: Looking for somewhere to end your day in Chiang Mai? HONG’s Sky Bar has an outdoor terrace overlooking Doi Suthep and the city, with cocktails and Chinese sharing dishes. Arrive before sunset with your partner or friends and enjoy a conversation as the mountain backdrop gives way to the city’s evening lights.

facts.booking: Book a table through the hotel’s official reservation page; bookings may be cancelled if you are 15 minutes late
facts.rain: The bar may close in rain or poor weather
facts.address: 153 Sridonchai Road, Chang Khlan, Chiang Mai 50100, Thailand

reasons.title: From mountain views to city lights
reasons.text: Come before sunset if you would like to see Doi Suthep. Talk with your companions while looking towards the mountain and town, then enjoy the city lights after dark. After a busy sightseeing day, this is a chance to slow down and see another side of Chiang Mai.

reasons.title: An evening of cocktails and Chinese sharing dishes
reasons.text: Try cocktails using Thai honey, lemongrass and Chiang Mai tea with Chinese small plates. It suits a drink and several dishes to share with friends or a partner. As an outdoor bar, it can close in rain or poor weather: keep another evening plan in mind if rain is forecast.

hongs-sky-bar.menu: Cocktails using Thai honey, lemongrass and Chiang Mai tea accompany Chinese sharing dishes. A bao bun and selected drink set is 550 baht net daily from 16:00 to 21:00. Weekday happy hour from 17:00 to 19:00 offers a second glass with selected cocktails and wines. Check that your chosen drink is included before ordering.
hongs-sky-bar.recommended: Enjoy Chiang Mai’s evening scenery over cocktails with friends or your partner. Mountain views followed by city lights make this a place to talk at leisure after daytime sightseeing.
hongs-sky-bar.bestTime: Arrive before sunset and take your time if you want to see both Doi Suthep and the city lights.
hongs-sky-bar.budget: The bao bun and selected drink set costs 550 baht net and is available from 16:00 to 21:00. It suits a light bite and drink; order any additional dishes or drinks separately.

taxi.instructions: Search for “InterContinental Chiang Mai The Mae Ping” in Grab or Bolt. In a taxi, show the driver the English or Thai sentence below. At the hotel, ask staff for directions to HONG’s Sky Bar.
taxi.english: Please take me to HONG’s Sky Bar, InterContinental Chiang Mai The Mae Ping, 153 Sridonchai Road, Chang Khlan, Chiang Mai.
taxi.thai: ไปโรงแรม InterContinental Chiang Mai The Mae Ping ถนนศรีดอนไชย จะไป HONG’s Sky Bar
taxi.destination: 153 Sridonchai Road, Chang Khlan, Chiang Mai 50100, Thailand

sources: Official hotel views, menu and opening times
Hotel-linked reservations, dress code and weather policy
faq: Who should I visit with?
It suits cocktails and Chiang Mai’s evening views with friends or a partner. Look towards Doi Suthep, then enjoy the city lights, with time to talk after the day’s sightseeing.
When can I see both the mountain and city lights?
Arrive before sunset. You can see Doi Suthep and the town while it is light, then the city lights later. Stay for cocktails and food rather than leaving as soon as you have seen the view.
What happens if I am late for my booking?
The booking may be cancelled if you arrive 15 minutes late. Allow enough time for sightseeing and travel so you can begin the evening without rushing.
Does it open in the rain?
Rain or poor weather may close the bar. Clear weather suits enjoying the mountain and city from the open terrace. If rain is forecast, check whether the bar is operating before setting out.

baba-nest.name: Baba Nest
baba-nest.intro: For an evening watching the sea around sunset in Phuket, visit Baba Nest. An infinity pool surrounds the outdoor deck at Sri Panwa, with the Andaman Sea and islands beyond. It suits an anniversary with your partner or cocktails with friends. The bar operates by reservation from 17:00 to 20:00, so leave this part of your evening free to enjoy the changing sky.

facts.minimumSpend: 1,500 baht net per hotel guest; 3,000 baht net per non-resident guest, required to confirm the reservation
facts.booking: Advance reservation required; seats held for 15 minutes after booking time; contact ahead if delayed
facts.rain: Closes in rain; non-resident minimum spend can transfer to Baba Poolclub or Baba Soul Food in bad weather
facts.closed: Open daily with no regular closing day; closes in rain
facts.address: 88 Moo 8, Sakdidej Road, Cape Panwa, Wichit, Phuket 83000, Thailand

reasons.title: Sea views beyond the pool
reasons.text: Enjoy the view of the infinity pool surrounding the deck and the sea beyond, seeming to run together. Look out across nearby islands and Phuket’s south-eastern peninsula. Share cocktails and watch the sky change colour for an evening to remember together.

reasons.title: Take your time with cocktails and tapas
reasons.text: Pair cocktails, wine or champagne with Mexican tapas. Choose an evening when you have time to enjoy your drinks and the view rather than hurrying through dinner. Pick dishes with your partner or friends and linger beside the sea.

reasons.title: Plan around reservations and weather
reasons.text: Advance booking and a minimum spend apply. Opening hours are 17:00–20:00, so plan for sunset rather than a late-night drink. The bar closes in rain: read the booking conditions and consider the forecast when choosing your date.

baba-nest.menu: Cocktails, wine and champagne are served with Mexican tapas.
baba-nest.recommended: For those who enjoy broad sunset views of the sea and islands, or are planning an anniversary evening.
baba-nest.bestTime: It opens from 17:00 to 20:00. Book around the evening sea and sky rather than a late-night visit.
baba-nest.budget: Minimum spend is 1,500 baht per hotel guest or 3,000 baht per non-resident guest, net. Check the payment conditions when booking; this is a minimum spend rather than a separate admission fee.
baba-nest.reservation: Advance reservations are required. Cancellation or a no-show incurs the full 1,500 baht per hotel guest or 3,000 baht per non-resident guest. Non-resident minimum spend is non-refundable; in bad weather it can be used at Baba Poolclub or Baba Soul Food.

access.name: Sri Panwa Phuket
access.instructions: Search for “Sri Panwa Phuket” in Grab or Bolt. Ask staff for directions to Baba Nest on arrival. If staying through the evening, arrange the return journey too.

taxi.instructions: Show your taxi driver the English or Thai sentence below.
taxi.english: Please take me to Baba Nest at Sri Panwa Phuket.
taxi.thai: ไปบาบาเนสต์ที่ศรีพันวา ถนนศักดิเดช แหลมพันวา ภูเก็ต

sources: Baba Nest official hours, reservations, guest policies and menu
faq: Must I book?

Yes, an advance reservation is required. Choose your date and companions before booking. Seats are held for 15 minutes after the reservation time, so leave enough time after sightseeing. Contact the venue ahead if you expect to be late.
What is the minimum spend?

It is 1,500 baht per hotel guest and 3,000 baht per non-resident guest, net. This is required to confirm your booking, so include it in your cocktail and tapas budget. Read the payment terms rather than treating it as a separate entry fee.
What happens if it rains?

Baba Nest closes in rain. In bad weather, a non-resident guest’s minimum spend can transfer to Baba Poolclub or Baba Soul Food. Read this condition before booking if the sea and sunset are your main reason for visiting.
Can I visit late at night?
It opens daily from 17:00 to 20:00. Plan for sunset scenery rather than late-night drinks, leaving enough time to settle in before the sun goes down.

star-silavadee.name: STAR by Silavadee
star-silavadee.intro: Visit STAR for an evening looking across the sea on Koh Samui. From the rooftop of Silavadee Pool Spa Resort, enjoy Western dishes and cocktails above Lamai Bay. Four sunken tables in the infinity pool are a distinctive seating option. Come for dinner with your partner or a drink with friends. An early-evening arrival gives you time to enjoy the sea before continuing to a leisurely meal together.

facts.address: 208/66 Moo 4, Maret, Koh Samui 84310, Thailand
facts.booking: Use Make a Reservation on the official venue page

reasons.title: Begin the evening above Lamai Bay
reasons.text: Look down over Lamai Bay from the resort rooftop. Arrive early in the evening to see the sea in daylight, then enjoy cocktails or wine and continue to dinner, with time to take in the view together.

reasons.title: Four sunken tables in the pool
reasons.text: Four tables sit low within the infinity pool. They suit couples wanting distinctive seating alongside the sea view. Lounge beds and bar stools are also available: ask about your preferred seat when booking.

star-silavadee.menu: Enjoy Western dinner dishes, cocktails and wine. Cocktails include Espresso Martini, Lychee Martini and Tom Yum Siam.
star-silavadee.recommended: For couples wanting dinner with a sea view or friends sharing cocktails and stories from the holiday. Mention any seating preference when making the reservation.
star-silavadee.bestTime: It opens at 17:30. Arrive early in the evening to combine daylight sea views with dinner. Leave time for a cocktail looking across Lamai Bay before your meal.
star-silavadee.seating: There are four sunken pool tables, regular dining seats, lounge beds and bar stools, with 42 seats in total. Ask about your preferred seating when booking.

access.name: Silavadee Resort
access.instructions: Silavadee is on Laem Nan Beach between Chaweng and Lamai. Search for “Silavadee Pool Spa Resort” for your journey. Show the hotel name and address together to make the destination clear, then ask staff for directions to STAR on arrival.

taxi.instructions: When travelling by taxi or car, show the driver the English or Thai sentence below. At Silavadee, ask staff for directions to STAR rooftop.
taxi.english: Please take me to Silavadee Pool Spa Resort, Lamai, Koh Samui. I am going to STAR rooftop bar.
taxi.thai: ไปศิลาวดี พูล สปา รีสอร์ท ละไม เกาะสมุย จะไปสตาร์
taxi.destination: Silavadee Pool Spa Resort · 208/66 Moo 4, Maret, Koh Samui 84310, Thailand

sources: STAR official views, seating, hours and reservations
faq: Who would enjoy STAR?
It suits dinner overlooking the sea with your partner, or cocktails and holiday conversation with friends. Choose it when you would like Lamai Bay as the backdrop to your meal.
Can I sit at a table in the pool?
There are four sunken pool tables, alongside regular dining seats, lounge beds and bar stools. Ask about your preference when booking. Total capacity is 42 seats.
When can I combine sea views with dinner?
It opens at 17:30. Come early for the sea in daylight, start with a cocktail and stay for dinner. Kitchen orders close at 22:30, so allow time for your meal when booking late.
How do I book?
Use “Make a Reservation” on the official venue page. Choose your companions, date and time, and ask about a pool table or any seating preference at the same time.
What should I wear?

The official booking guidance specifies smart casual. Think of neat clothes for an evening out: a collared shirt and long trousers for men, or a dress or blouse for women are examples. These gendered examples are suggestions to help you prepare.

horizon-pattaya.name: Horizon Rooftop Restaurant & Bar
horizon-pattaya.intro: For a dinner to remember on your Pattaya holiday, head up to Horizon. This rooftop restaurant on Hilton Pattaya’s 34th floor pairs dinner and cocktails with views across Pattaya Bay. It suits an anniversary with your partner or a special dinner with your parents. Arrive around sunset and take your time as the sea and sky change colour and the city lights appear.

facts.address: 333/101 Moo 9, Nong Prue, Bang Lamung, Pattaya, Chonburi 20260, Thailand
facts.booking: Use Horizon’s Book a Table link on Hilton’s official Dining page

reasons.title: Finish a beach day on the 34th floor
reasons.text: See the Pattaya beach you walked along earlier from above. The outdoor terrace opens across Pattaya Bay; after dark, lights follow the shoreline. Share a cocktail and talk about the places you have seen that day.

reasons.title: Stay for dinner as well as the view
reasons.text: Choose dishes such as a seafood tower, tomahawk steak or lamb shank. Indoor dining and an outdoor terrace suit an evening meal with a view. For an anniversary or dinner with your parents, leave enough time so you do not have to rush to your next stop.

reasons.title: DJ music for the evening
reasons.text: Live DJ music accompanies the evening. It suits couples or friends wanting music and views with dinner. If considering the terrace, look at indoor seating too in case of heat or rain.

horizon-pattaya.menu: Dishes include a seafood tower, Australian Angus tomahawk steak, slow-cooked lamb shank and snowfish with miso sauce.
horizon-pattaya.recommended: For those wanting a dinner with a view as part of a Pattaya beach holiday.
horizon-pattaya.bestTime: Come around sunset to see the colours of sea and sky, or after dark for the city lights.
horizon-pattaya.seating: Indoor seating and an outdoor terrace are available. Ask about a terrace table when booking if you want to face the sea.

access.name: Hilton Pattaya
access.instructions: Search for “Hilton Pattaya” in Grab or Bolt. At the hotel, ask staff for directions to Horizon Rooftop.

taxi.instructions: Show your taxi driver the English or Thai sentence below.
taxi.english: Please take me to Hilton Pattaya. I am going to Horizon Rooftop Restaurant & Bar.
taxi.thai: ไปโรงแรมฮิลตัน พัทยา จะไปร้าน Horizon ชั้น 34

sources: Hilton official Horizon floor, views, menu, DJ and reservations
faq: Who should I go with?
It suits dinner and city views with your partner or parents. The 34th-floor sea and city outlook makes the meal itself a special part of your holiday.
When is best for the view?
Arrive around sunset to watch the colours of sea and sky change. Stay for dinner and see the city lights come on too. Mention your terrace preference when booking.
What food is served?
Options include a seafood tower, Australian Angus tomahawk steak, lamb shank and snowfish with miso sauce. Browse the menu together and decide whether you want dinner or cocktails with the view.
Where do I book?
Use Horizon’s “Book a Table” on Hilton’s official Dining page. Choose your companions and date, then select a time for your meal.

mahanakhon-skywalk.name: Mahanakhon SkyWalk
mahanakhon-skywalk.building: King Power Mahanakhon · indoor 74th floor and outdoor 78th floor
mahanakhon-skywalk.intro: Head up to Mahanakhon SkyWalk to see Bangkok in every direction. Explore the indoor observation deck on the 74th floor and the outdoor deck on the 78th, then look down through the glass floor 310m above the city. A viewing point at 314m is another feature. Visit with friends who enjoy photography or family who want to see Bangkok from above. Allow time for the different indoor and outdoor perspectives.

facts.children: Child tickets are categorised for ages 8–12
facts.address: 114 Narathiwas Ratchanakarin Road, Silom, Bang Rak, Bangkok
facts.booking: Choose tickets for your date, time slot and age category on the official ticket page

reasons.title: See Bangkok indoors and outdoors
reasons.text: View Bangkok from the 74th-floor indoor deck and 78th-floor outdoor deck. Different spaces give you different ways to enjoy the same city. Explore with family or friends and pick out features of the skyline.

reasons.title: A glass floor above the city
reasons.text: The glass floor 310m high is a distinctive experience here. Share the view beneath your feet with someone who enjoys heights. If it feels uncomfortable, focus on the city views without forcing yourself onto the glass.

mahanakhon-skywalk.recommended: For families or friends who enjoy city views and photography from above. If someone is uneasy about the glass floor, each of you can enjoy the visit in a way that feels comfortable.
mahanakhon-skywalk.entrance: After the ticket check at the ground-floor main entrance and ticket office, pass the photo area and digital corridor and take the lift to floor 74. Floor 75 is the boarding area for the glass lift to the upper levels.

access.name: Chong Nonsi BTS station
access.instructions: From Exit 3 of Chong Nonsi on the BTS Silom Line, go to King Power Mahanakhon’s main entrance. Prepare your ticket at the ground-floor ticket office and follow the observation-lift signs.

taxi.instructions: Show the driver the English or Thai destination below when travelling by taxi or car. Ask staff for directions to Mahanakhon SkyWalk on arrival.
taxi.english: Mahanakhon SkyWalk, 114 Narathiwas Ratchanakarin Road, Silom, Bang Rak, Bangkok
taxi.thai: มหานคร สกายวอล์ค คิง เพาเวอร์ มหานคร 114 ถนนนราธิวาสราชนครินทร์ สีลม กรุงเทพฯ
taxi.destination: 114 Narathiwas Ratchanakarin Road, Silom, Bang Rak, Bangkok

sources: Official operator visitor, ticket and transport information
faq: Is this the same as Sky Beach bar?

They share a building, but SkyWalk is for visiting indoor and outdoor observation decks. Choose a SkyWalk ticket for the city views and glass floor. Treat bar access and observation tickets as separate visits.
How should I choose a ticket?
Select the date, time slot and age category on the official ticket page. Child tickets cover ages 8–12, so choose according to each child’s age.
How do I get there by train?
Leave Chong Nonsi on the BTS Silom Line through Exit 3 and go to King Power Mahanakhon’s main entrance. Follow the ground-floor ticket-office and observation-lift directions.
Which floors can I visit?
The indoor observation deck is on floor 74 and the outdoor deck on floor 78. Allow time for both to enjoy the city from different spaces.

baiyoke-observatory.name: Baiyoke Sky Observatory
baiyoke-observatory.building: Baiyoke Sky Hotel · 77th-floor observation area and 84th-floor revolving deck
baiyoke-observatory.intro: After shopping in Pratunam, head up to Baiyoke Sky Observatory for Bangkok views from above. The hotel has an observation area on floor 77 and a revolving deck on floor 84. It suits continuing the day with the friends you shopped with or anyone keen on city views. Add time at the observatory if you would like more than shopping before heading back.

facts.hours: Daily 10:00–22:00; may vary over long holiday periods
facts.entryFee: Official special promotion: 450 baht net, including one drink at the 83rd-floor rooftop bar
facts.address: 222 Soi Ratchaprarop 3, Ratchaprarop Road, Ratchathewi, Bangkok 10400

reasons.title: Floor 77 and the revolving deck on floor 84
reasons.text: Explore both viewing floors and look across central Bangkok. The revolving deck on floor 84 is a particular feature. Take in the city from above with your companions.

reasons.title: Add a view to your Pratunam shopping day
reasons.text: If you plan to shop around Pratunam, fit the observatory into the same day. Finish with friends talking about your shopping and looking across the city.

baiyoke-observatory.recommended: Visit with friends shopping in Pratunam or companions who enjoy city views. It suits adding an observatory visit to a shopping day.

access.name: Baiyoke Sky Hotel
access.instructions: If travelling by car, use the directions below to see the building’s location. The destination is Baiyoke Sky Hotel; show the driver both the hotel name and address.

taxi.instructions: Show the driver the English or Thai destination below if travelling by taxi or car. At the building, ask staff for directions to Baiyoke Sky Observatory.
taxi.english: Baiyoke Sky Observatory, 222 Soi Ratchaprarop 3, Ratchaprarop Road, Ratchathewi, Bangkok 10400
taxi.thai: จุดชมวิวโรงแรมใบหยกสกาย 222 ซอยราชปรารภ 3 ถนนราชปรารภ ราชเทวี กรุงเทพฯ
taxi.destination: 222 Soi Ratchaprarop 3, Ratchaprarop Road, Ratchathewi, Bangkok 10400

sources: Official hotel observation decks, admission and hours
faq: Which floors have observation areas?
Visit the observation area on floor 77 and revolving deck on floor 84. Distinguish an observation-deck visit from a drink at the rooftop bar.
Does the ticket include a drink?
The official special promotion listed here is 450 baht net and includes one drink at the 83rd-floor rooftop bar. As a promotion, check that the same package is on sale for your date before buying.
Can I visit after shopping?
Opening hours are daily 10:00–22:00. Plan to follow shopping around Pratunam with a visit to the observatory. Hours may differ during long holiday periods.

doi-suthep-viewpoint.name: Wat Phra That Doi Suthep Viewpoint
doi-suthep-viewpoint.building: Wat Phra That Doi Suthep · viewpoint within the temple grounds
doi-suthep-viewpoint.intro: Head up to Doi Suthep to combine a Chiang Mai temple visit with views over the city. Explore the hilltop temple’s golden chedi and Lanna architecture, then look down across Chiang Mai from the terrace. With parents or friends who enjoy temples, take your time walking, taking photographs and pausing over the city view.

facts.address: Huai Kaeo Road, Suthep, Mueang Chiang Mai, Chiang Mai

reasons.title: A golden chedi and views over the city
reasons.text: Admire the golden chedi and Lanna architecture before walking to the terrace. Looking down over Chiang Mai gives a different view from exploring its streets. Companions who enjoy temple architecture can combine the buildings and outlook in one visit.

reasons.title: Climb beside the naga sculptures
reasons.text: The 306 steps guarded by naga sculptures are part of the visit. Walk slowly together and take in the carvings. A cable car is another option if the steps are difficult. With parents or children, choose the way up according to their comfort and fitness.

doi-suthep-viewpoint.recommended: Visit with parents or friends who enjoy temple architecture and city views. After the golden chedi, pause on the terrace above Chiang Mai. This is a viewing space within temple grounds, so plan a temple visit rather than a bar stop.
doi-suthep-viewpoint.entrance: Climb the 306 naga-lined steps or take the cable car from the temple approach. If you want to see the sculptures on foot, take your time. Once at the temple, follow local signs to the viewing area.

access.name: Red songthaew
access.instructions: Before boarding a red songthaew, agree whether it goes to Doi Suthep temple, whether the journey is one way or return, and the total fare. With parents or children, plan the return before setting out too. At the temple approach, use the stairs or cable car.

taxi.instructions: Show your taxi driver the English or Thai sentence below. Your destination is Doi Suthep temple; from the approach, go up by stairs or cable car.
taxi.english: Wat Phra That Doi Suthep, please.
taxi.thai: ไปวัดพระธาตุดอยสุเทพด้วยครับ/ค่ะ

sources: Tourism Authority of Thailand: temple, views and access
Tourism Authority of Thailand: temple information
faq: Who would enjoy Doi Suthep?

Visit with parents or friends who enjoy temple architecture and city views. See the golden chedi, then pause on the terrace above Chiang Mai. This is a viewpoint within temple grounds, so plan a temple visit rather than ordering drinks at a bar.
Must I climb the steps?

No, a cable car is available too. Choose the 306 steps to see the naga carvings, or the cable car if a companion finds long walks difficult. At the temple, explore the architecture on your way to the terrace.
How do I use a songthaew?

You can take a red songthaew from Chiang Mai to Doi Suthep. Before boarding, agree the temple destination, one-way or return journey and total price. Plan the return too so you can continue your day at leisure after enjoying the view.
Does the map pin mark the viewing terrace?
The map marks the temple complex. On arrival, go up by stairs or cable car, then follow local signs to the viewing terrace. Enjoy the temple architecture as you walk through the grounds.

sky-bar.name: Sky Bar by lebua
sky-bar.intro: Head up to Sky Bar by lebua for cocktails above Bangkok’s night-time lights. From the open-air bar beside the golden dome, look down over the Chao Phraya River and central city. If visiting with friends who have seen The Hangover Part II, try its film-linked Hangovertini. It suits an evening enjoying Bangkok together after dinner.

facts.children: Children aged 7 and over may enter with an adult
facts.dressCode: Smart casual; no men’s sleeveless tops, sportswear, swimwear or flip-flops
facts.address: 64th Floor, State Tower Bangkok, 1055 Silom Road, Bangrak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

reasons.title: River and city beside the golden dome
reasons.text: Look over the Chao Phraya and central Bangkok from the outdoor bar, with the golden dome beside you. Enjoy the elevated night-time view, talk about your holiday with friends or spend the evening looking at the city lights with your partner.

reasons.title: A Hangovertini and a film conversation
reasons.text: The Hangovertini is the bar’s cocktail connected with The Hangover Part II. With friends who have seen the film, recall familiar scenes and add another memory to your Bangkok trip.

sky-bar.recommended: For an evening of cocktails with friends who have seen The Hangover Part II or a partner who enjoys city lights.
sky-bar.bestTime: Arrive before sunset to see the city and sky, then stay after dark for Bangkok’s lights.

taxi.instructions: Search for “lebua at State Tower” in Grab or Bolt. In a taxi, show the driver the English or Thai sentence below. On arrival, tell staff you are visiting Sky Bar.
taxi.english: Please take me to lebua at State Tower, State Tower Bangkok, 1055 Silom Road, Bangrak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand. I am going to Sky Bar by lebua.
taxi.thai: ไปโรงแรมเลอบัว แอท สเตท ทาวเวอร์ ถนนสีลม จะไป Sky Bar by lebua

faq: Who would enjoy Sirocco?

It is a good choice for an anniversary with your partner or a special dinner for your parents. Dining beneath the golden dome with Bangkok’s city lights below suits an evening you would like to remember together. Choose a day when you do not need to rush elsewhere after dinner.
When should I visit for jazz?

Choose Tuesday to Sunday for live jazz. The music adds to the evening as you dine looking over the city lights. Monday has background music instead. Ask for the performance times when booking so you can choose your meal time accordingly.
Can I bring children?

Yes, families can dine together and children of all ages are welcome. Dress children in neat clothes for going out, rather than sportswear or flip-flops. If you plan to visit another bar in the building afterwards, remember that each bar has its own minimum age.
What should I wear?

Think of clothes for a smart evening out. Men could wear a shirt or polo with neat trousers and loafers; women could choose a dress or blouse with a skirt or trousers. Smart shorts and sandals are allowed, so a suit or high heels are not essential. Sportswear, swimwear and flip-flops are prohibited, as are men’s sleeveless tops.
How do I book, and what are the cancellation terms?

Once you have chosen the date and companions, select a time through the official booking link above. The deposit is deducted from your meal bill and the booking is confirmed only when payment is received. Standard reservations can be cancelled or changed free of charge up to 72 hours before the visit. After that, cancellation, changes and no-shows forfeit the deposit, so book once your plans are settled. Special-event days and group bookings have different refund terms.
Can I eat late in the evening?

Yes, but opening until 00:30 does not mean every dish is available until then. Set-menu orders close at 23:00, à la carte at 23:30 and snacks at midnight. If you want to enjoy a course meal slowly, book earlier in the evening for time with both the food and the view.
Can I bring a suitcase or large shopping bag?

Large bags, suitcases and shopping bags are not allowed, and there is no luggage storage. Enjoy shopping or sightseeing during the day, then return to your accommodation to leave bags and change before Sirocco. If visiting on checkout day, arrange somewhere to keep your luggage during dinner first.
